channel.title: TRIAD
channel.description: TRIAD is an independent fashion and culture collective — a magazine, a news desk and a visual archive for fashion, art, music and underground culture.

item.title: Three Forces — The First Shoot
item.description: Forest, stone, the Icelandic coast. The first pictures TRIAD made as TRIAD — no stylist, no studio, no budget. Just the three of us, a camera and whatever was in the wardrobe.
